notes: Drona Parva, thirteenth day. Chakravyuha. Abhimanyu is a youthful Kuru warrior prince (adult warrior proportions, Amar Chitra maharathi) — not a child. No gore: gold shaft-light, composed last stand with a chariot wheel, dusk fall. Drona is the field commander (saffron acharya-warrior), not a garden sage. Jayadratha is the living gate at the rim. Closing vow is Arjuna at sunset.

drona.face: Aged acharya-warrior, noble lined face, long white beard and mustache (guru on the field, not a garden sage)
drona.hair: White hair in a saffron-bound topknot, rudraksha — no Kuru silver diadem of Bhishma
drona.costume: Saffron angavastram over pale gold-white armor, bow of the guru, cream dhoti

abhimanyu.face: Youthful Kuru warrior prince, adult warrior proportions, determined dark eyes, light mustache — distinct from Arjuna, never a child
abhimanyu.hair: Dark hair, small gold diadem (not Arjuna’s heavy crown), no peacock feather
abhimanyu.costume: Indigo-blue armor with gold inlay, cream sash, quiver and bow — never flower garland, never saffron robes

jayadratha.face: Adult Sindhu king, proud mustache, hard gaze
jayadratha.hair: Dark hair under a jeweled royal crown
jayadratha.costume: Jewel-tone crimson and gold Sindhu armor, shield — field king, not a forest abductor

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09–10
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dark eyes, serene

armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore
